item: A world-events catalogue that was not read is said, never counted as every floor country missing
refs: PR #2234; docket row 273; 0.6 gate row A; R696
key_paths: src/events/catalog.py; src/civic/coverage_floor.py; src/monitoring/kpi.py; src/api/events.py; src/api/diagnostics/system.py; src/static/app-agenda.js; scripts/elections_readback.py; tests/test_elections_catalogue_state_row273.py
summary: The curated catalogue is read once with a state (present, absent, empty, unreadable with the error's class and no path; all rows refused is unreadable). When not present, the floor counts, the tier report and K13 are null beside the state, /api/events and its facets carry it, the Agenda says it in one line x12, and the read-back prints it. An unparsable file no longer raises out of its callers.
